_note: Delaware Beach Finds editorial control over the ingested calendar. This is the ONLY events file a human should edit. data/events-generated.json is machine-produced and is overwritten on every ingest run. Everything here is keyed by the generated event id, which you can find in data/events-generated.json or in the data-event-id attribute on the rendered card.

_howTo.feature: Add { "id": "rehoboth-52687", "featured": true } to overrides. Featured events lead the Today and Weekend blocks and carry an Editor's Pick flag. Machine ingestion NEVER sets this — an editor does.
_howTo.suppress: Add { "id": "...", "suppress": true }. The event disappears from every surface without touching the generated file.
_howTo.note: Add { "id": "...", "note": "Parking fills by ten; the Grove lot is closed this month." } to attach a short DBF line under the listing.
_howTo.retitle: Add { "id": "...", "title": "Rehoboth Farmers' Market" } when the source title is ugly or truncated.
_howTo.priority: Add { "id": "...", "priority": 10 }. Higher sorts earlier within its block.
_howTo.correct: Add { "id": "...", "startTime": "18:30", "provenance": "Confirmed by phone with the venue 2026-08-19" } to correct a factual field. Always record provenance for a factual override.

_rules: Machine ingestion answers what exists. This file answers what is worth highlighting.
Never set sponsored here. Paid placement belongs to the sponsor system, not editorial.
A factual override without provenance is a guess — record where the correction came from.
